Subsection 1: VPD across Australia
- **Driver importance across sites**
- **GAMs - predictability**
- GPP~VPD responses

Within site RF to get predictor rankings
Compare to a within site GAM 

```{r}
####
##  Fit a GAM and a Random Forest to predict flux GPP across multiple sites
##
##  Assumes: site_daily is a named list of daily dataframes, already loaded
##
##  Fixes vs original:
##    - trainData typo -> train_data
##    - rolling CWD now computed BEFORE train/test split
##    - standardise() now uses training-set params to scale test data (no leakage)
##    - SW_rad added to GAM (was missing in original)
##    - loops over all sites in site_daily
####

library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(zoo)
library(mgcv)
library(RColorBrewer)

# Standardise using means/sds from a *reference* dataframe (avoids data leakage)
standardise <- function(df, vars_to_scale, ref_df = NULL) {
  df_scaled <- df
  if (is.null(ref_df)) ref_df <- df
  for (v in vars_to_scale) {
    m  <- mean(ref_df[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)
    s  <- sd(ref_df[[v]],   na.rm = TRUE)
    df_scaled[[v]] <- (df[[v]] - m) / s
  }
  return(df_scaled)
}

calc_metrics <- function(obs, pred) {
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((obs - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
  rsq  <- cor(obs, pred, use = "complete.obs")^2
  nse  <- 1 - sum((obs - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE) /
              sum((obs - mean(obs, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  data.frame(RMSE = rmse, Rsq = rsq, NSE = nse)
}


predictors <- c("Tair", "SW_rad", "VPD", "cumulative_cwd_7day")

results_list    <- list()
metrics_list    <- list()
importance_list <- list()

set.seed(123)

# Main loop over sites

for (site_names in names(sites_daily)) {
  
  cat("\n---", site_names, "---\n")
  df <- sites_daily[[site_names]]
  
  df <- df %>%
    filter(if_all(everything(), ~ . >= -9000)) %>%
    drop_na()
  
  if (nrow(df) < 100) {
    cat("  Skipping - too few rows after cleaning\n")
    next
  }
  
  df$cumulative_cwd_7day <- rollapply(
    df$cwd, width = 7, FUN = sum,
    align = "right", fill = NA, na.rm = TRUE
  )
  df <- df %>% drop_na()
  
  idx        <- createDataPartition(df$GPP, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
  train_data <- df[idx, ]
  test_data  <- df[-idx, ]
  
  train_data <- standardise(train_data, predictors)
  test_data  <- standardise(test_data,  predictors, ref_df = train_data)
  
  rf_model <- randomForest(
    GPP ~ Tair + SW_rad + VPD + cumulative_cwd_7day,
    data  = train_data,
    ntree = 500,
    mtry  = 3
  )
  
  pred_rf    <- predict(rf_model, test_data)
  metrics_rf <- calc_metrics(test_data$GPP, pred_rf)
  cat("  RF  -> RMSE:", round(metrics_rf$RMSE, 3),
      " R2:", round(metrics_rf$Rsq, 3),
      " NSE:", round(metrics_rf$NSE, 3), "\n")
  
  # Fixed: site_name -> site_names (both lines)
  imp          <- as.data.frame(importance(rf_model))
  imp$variable <- rownames(imp)
  imp$site     <- site_names
  importance_list[[site_names]] <- imp
  
  gam_model <- gam(
    GPP ~ s(Tair) + s(SW_rad) + s(VPD) + s(cumulative_cwd_7day),
    data   = train_data,
    method = "REML"
  )
  
  pred_gam    <- predict(gam_model, newdata = test_data)
  metrics_gam <- calc_metrics(test_data$GPP, pred_gam)
  cat("  GAM -> RMSE:", round(metrics_gam$RMSE, 3),
      " R2:", round(metrics_gam$Rsq, 3),
      " NSE:", round(metrics_gam$NSE, 3), "\n")
  
  results_list[[site_names]] <- data.frame(
    site          = site_names,
    date          = as.Date(test_data$date),
    Observed      = test_data$GPP,
    Predicted_RF  = pred_rf,
    Predicted_GAM = as.numeric(pred_gam)
  )
  
  metrics_list[[site_names]] <- data.frame(
    site  = site_names,
    model = c("RF", "GAM"),
    RMSE  = c(metrics_rf$RMSE,  metrics_gam$RMSE),
    Rsq   = c(metrics_rf$Rsq,   metrics_gam$Rsq),
    NSE   = c(metrics_rf$NSE,   metrics_gam$NSE)
  )
}


# Combine

results_all    <- bind_rows(results_list)
metrics_all    <- bind_rows(metrics_list)
importance_all <- bind_rows(importance_list)

print(metrics_all)

```

```{r}

# 1. Observed vs Predicted scatter, faceted by site
results_all %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(Predicted_RF, Predicted_GAM),
               names_to = "model", values_to = "Predicted") %>%
  mutate(model = recode(model,
                        Predicted_RF  = "Random Forest",
                        Predicted_GAM = "GAM")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Observed, y = Predicted, colour = model)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30") +
  facet_wrap(~ site) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = brewer.pal(3, "Set2")[1:2]) +
  labs(x = expression("Observed GPP" ~ ("g C" ~ m^{-2} ~ d^{-1})),
       y = expression("Predicted GPP" ~ ("g C" ~ m^{-2} ~ d^{-1})),
       colour = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position  = "top",
        strip.background = element_blank())

# 2. R² by site and model
ggplot(metrics_all, aes(x = reorder(site, Rsq), y = Rsq, fill = model)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = brewer.pal(3, "Set2")[1:2]) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = expression(R^2), fill = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# 3. RF variable importance across sites
importance_all %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(variable, IncNodePurity),
             y = IncNodePurity, fill = site)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Increase in Node Purity", fill = "Site") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```
